title: Juice N Power Vimtonic 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just like the nostalgic purple pop of yore, Vimtonic is bursting with juicy tones of grapes, raspberries and blackcurrants in a delightfully smooth and fruity sweet vape with a little soda tickle on the exhale. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks.
